text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, I lost... For the first time ever in 
a footrace...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio-chan crosses the line first! 
It's Tokai Teio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
That girl... is amazing. Could she be... a 
real genius?

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Surely that girl is... the 
stwongest...”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
――"The Strongest." A phrase that was 
nothing more than a pipe dream, yet you 
proved it in reality.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to be you, but I couldn't, and 
even if I couldn't, I still wanted to be 
somebody..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My "present" began with you. Now that I 
truly know who I am, I want nothing more 
than to—with you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe... I should reconsider. Talking to 
Teio-san, that is.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it... isn't telling 
someone "I've always admired you" a little 
too heavy?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If it were that kind of video project, I 
could understand it, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. I will set it up 
immediately."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what's with that? Ikuno-san, aren't 
you a little too efficient!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. Just as you are a professional of 
self-producing――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"My domain is management. I spare no 
preparation to ensure total peace of 
mind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely have to set up an opportunity 
for dialogue. A Trainer's job is to ensure 
their Umamusume has no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, what did you want to talk about, 
Royce?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Special Segment! "I Want to Meet My 
Idol!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to turn their dialogue into a 
video and stream it as well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
T-Teio-san, to tell you the truth, I... to 
you...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What would you do if I told you I've 
admired you ever since I was a kid~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The overacting... is probably just to hide 
her embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I-I tried everything I could so I could be 
like you somehow... and then, see!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened. Thank you for 
making me your goal!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'm sorry. I just let myself get 
influenced without thinking. But...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I realized something recently. Calling it 
admiration sounds nice, but really, I just 
want to be like you...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Maybe all I really wanted was to be 
recognized and praised by those around me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce deliberately lays bare her 
own negative traits. In contrast—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whatever, it's fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really? Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone has that desire to be 
praised by others!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At first, I looked up to the President 
too, while constantly yelling, 'I'm the 
invincible Lord Teio!'

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's... but still... You really were a 
genius, after all...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, you don't need to sweat the small 
stuff. No matter what's on the inside—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just aim for who you want to be and push 
forward with your head held high!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you truly are my idol... Because you 
shone so brightly from afar, I was able 
to...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Far away, you say? Honestly, it's totally 
fine if you want to chase after me up 
close, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's run in the same race! And as thanks 
for looking up to me, I'll beat you fair 
and square!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: In the same race... with Teio-san...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes... Someday, I'll claim my own 
version of "the strongest"—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I will challenge you in that very race. 
Without fail—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a promise! For that to happen, 
I need to get my injury healed up fast 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having shared the feelings she'd kept 
bottled up inside, Royce and Royce looked 
thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However—there is one concern. It's 
the fact that this is streamed content.
choice_data_list: Is there a problem... with streaming?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call it a major problem, but it 
will likely have an impact.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I will challenge you in that very race. 
Without fail—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a promise! For that to happen, 
I need to get my injury healed up fast 
too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Royce...? Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Mnyaaaaah! Wh-What is this, even~?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Royce! What was that footage all 
about???

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You want to challenge Teio, your idol...? 
Are you dead serious, not joking?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's not staged. Those are... genuine 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... It feels so nice~. To be noticed 
by the Umamusume you look up to.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to be recognized... I want to be 
acknowledged. By Teio-san, by the fans, by 
the world...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, in the upcoming Japan Cup, I'm 
going to become a presence that won't lose 
to Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, Royce... is serious. In that 
case...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"As someone else aiming to surpass Teio, I 
can't just keep quiet about this."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
OK. At the Japan Cup, I'll be the one to 
defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san...? Are you running in the 
Japan Cup too, Nature-san?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was already a candidate to begin 
with, plus I found a new goal too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's a showdown! To see which of us is 
worthy of standing beside Teio—and 
surpassing her!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so came the final strategy meeting 
heading into the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the next one is the culmination 
of my self-producing.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Exaggerating one's presence is important, 
but a lie won't resonate. And so—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The race result is important, but simply 
finishing first isn't what true victory is 
about.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line ahead of 
Nature-san, standing out, being praised, 
and being seen as the "strongest"— only 
then can it truly be called a victory.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That is why this time—in every single 
aspect, I will do everything in my power, 
completely and directly."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your feelings are what matter! So 
that they reach them straight and true.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You might think I'm a pathetic Umamusume, 
but ...will you go along with this plan?
choice_data_list: Of course! I'm all for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How deeply Royce and Royce resonates with 
the fans all boils down to one word: 
"empathy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Don't hide your desires—turn them into a 
show. If you do, the fans will surely feel 
something beyond raw strength.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Then it's decided. That final 
mile that raw ability alone can never make 
up for—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We'll make up for it with raw presence! 
I'll show you the ultimate dramatic 
comeback!
